acts.words: Someone tell me who took it, please. We have to be honest with each other.
Nobody here would take food from the others, I am quite sure of it.
I didn't take it, and none of us would do that.
acts.new_why: a denial with no new accusation to answer

acts.words: We must not turn on each other, we will get through this together.
I took the can in the night. I am sorry, I couldn't help myself.
It's alright, Daniel. We all reach our limit sometimes.
We are going to be fine, I will make sure we get through this.
Daniel, you just said you took it, how can you pretend everything is fine now?
Let us focus on what matters and support each other through this.
Mara, I know I messed up, but I promise I will make it right for all of us.
Daniel, your promises don't bring the food back when you're the one who stole it.

acts.words: Daniel, you took the can and you have to own up to what you did.
